sources.note: National Scholarship Portal (Government of India, MeitY) 'Schemes on NSP' listing. Shows the AICTE scheme entry 'AICTE - Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students ( Technical Degree) (Merit Based Scheme)' under the All India Council For Technical Education, with the open-cycle dates: Scheme Open from 01-06-2026, Student Application Open till 31-10-2026, verification stages till 15-11-2026 and 30-11-2026, and links to the scheme's Specifications and FAQ.

'GUIDELINES FOR AICTE - PRAGATI SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR GIRL STUDENTS - (DEGREE)' - the official scheme specifications PDF hosted on the NSP and linked from the scheme's own entry on the NSP schemes page. Contains eligibility, amount, payment mode and renewal rules.

awarding_body.detail: The NSP (Government of India's National Scholarship Portal) lists the scheme under 'All India Council For Technical Education' with the title 'AICTE - Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students ( Technical Degree)', and the official guidelines state the scheme is implemented and monitored by AICTE. This matches the record's awarding body (AICTE).
awarding_body.quote: AICTE - Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students ( Technical Degree) (Merit Based Scheme) ... Scheme will be implemented and monitored by the AICTE.

deadline.detail: The NSP entry for the exact scheme (Technical Degree) shows the currently open 2026-27 cycle: open from 01-06-2026 with student applications closing 31-10-2026 (still open on the check date, 12 October 2026), followed by verification stages closing 15-11-2026 and 30-11-2026. This matches the record's deadline label '31 October 2026 for student applications for academic year 2026-27' and deadline_date 2026-10-31.
deadline.quote: Scheme Open from : 01-06-2026 Student Application Open till : 31-10-2026 Defective Application Verification Open till:15-11-2026 Institute Verification Open till:15-11-2026 DNO/SNO/MNO Verification Open till:30-11-2026

eligibility.detail: Confirmed from the official guidelines: girl students admitted to the first year of a Degree level course or to the second year through lateral entry at an AICTE-approved institution; maximum two girl children per family; family income from all sources not more than Rs 8 lakh per annum. Renewal requires progression to the next year of study ('Student failing to get promoted to the next class/level would forfeit the scholarship').
eligibility.quote: 1) The girl candidate should be admitted to First year of Degree level course OR Second year of Degree level course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE approved Institution of respective year. 2) Maximum two girl child per family are eligible. 3) Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the current financial year.

funding.detail: The record says 'Partially Funded', which is accurate. The award is Rs 50,000 per annum paid as a lump sum towards college fee, computer purchase, stationeries, books, equipment and software - no grant is payable for hostel or medical charges, so it is not fully funded.
funding.quote: Rs. 50,000/- per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 4 years for first year admitted students and maximum 3 years for second year admitted students through lateral entry as lump sum amount towards payment of college fee, purchase of computer, stationeries, books, equipments, softwares etc. No other additional grant will be payable in lieu of hostel charges and medical charges etc.

degree_levels.detail: The record covers the Technical Degree scheme, and the levels offered are undergraduate degree courses (maximum 4 years for first-year entrants, 3 years for lateral entry). NSP lists the Diploma variant as a separate scheme, so 'Undergraduate' is the correct level for this record.
degree_levels.quote: The selection of candidate will be carried out solely on the basis of merit of qualifying examination to peruse the Technical Degree course from any of the AICTE approved institutions i.e. in First year or Second year (through lateral entry only)

recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Scheme listing on the National Scholarship Portal page 'Schemes on NSP' (scholarships.gov.in/All-Scholarships) under All India Council For Technical Education; official scheme guidelines (Degree) are linked there as Specifications. The 2026-27 cycle opened 01-06-2026 and closed student applications 31-10-2026; institutional/state verification stages closed 15-11-2026 and 30-11-2026. A new application window opens around June each year, so re-check the NSP listing each June for the next cycle. Funding is Rs 50,000 per annum as a lump sum (fee/computer/books etc.), paid via DBT by AICTE; 'Partially Funded' remains correct - hostel and medical charges are explicitly excluded. The guidelines PDF is dated 2020-21 but is the standing specification still linked on the NSP page; watch for a newer revision.
